Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

The Role

Square is building a best-in-class, high-impact field sales organization, and we are looking for an exceptional Territory Account Executive — someone who consistently exceeds expectations, takes full ownership of their territory, and brings Square's mission of economic empowerment directly to the businesses that need it most.

This is a field-driven, execution-focused role designed for individuals who thrive in dynamic, demanding environments. You will spend most of your week out in the market — meeting businesses, conducting live demos, and closing deals with confidence. The pace is fast, the expectations are high, and your ability to operate strategically and decisively will determine your success.

You will serve as Square's presence and competitive advantage in one of our highest-opportunity markets — responsible for building pipeline from the ground up, elevating Square's visibility in your community, establishing high-value partnerships, and helping local businesses grow through our ecosystem of industry-leading software and hardware.

If you are motivated by impactful work, driven to outperform, and eager to join a high-performance team with high standards, this role is built for you.

You will:

Lead your market with disciplined, in-person execution

  • Spend ~80% of your week in the field — walking your territory, engaging local businesses, and driving 50–60 targeted business visits each week.
  • Run a full-cycle, self-sourced sales motion: generate leads, identify needs, deliver compelling demos, and close deals across Square's full product suite.

Establish yourself as the go-to Square expert in your city

  • Build strong, trust-based relationships with local sellers by being present, reliable, and value-driven.
  • Partner cross-functionally to ensure a seamless onboarding experience and fast time-to-value for new sellers.
  • Implement a disciplined referral strategy to turn every new customer into future opportunities.

Build a high-velocity pipeline from the ground up

  • Develop a repeatable top-of-funnel engine through door-to-door outreach, community engagement, events, networking, and targeted partnerships.
  • Work with channel partners to generate a consistent, high-quality referral stream that grows over time.

Master your verticals and sell with precision

  • Build deep expertise in key verticals — including restaurants, retail, and services — to diagnose challenges and position the right Square solutions.
  • Sell consultatively and competitively, staying proactive and strategic throughout the sales cycle.

Achieve exceptional results in a high-accountability environment

  • Maintain strong operational rigor in Salesforce: track activity, manage pipeline, and forecast accurately.
  • Measure performance frequently and improve continuously.
  • Consistently exceed quota within a culture where high standards are the norm.

You have:

  • 3+ years of sales experience in a full cycle closing role with field sales experience
  • Experience exceeding sales targets, selling a diverse ecosystem of products, and closing complex deals
  • Ability to drive deals independently in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
  • Business development experience (e.g. hunting and cold calling)
  • Since this is a field position, you must have reliable transportation and live in the market you are serving
  • A collaborative and team player mentality
  • Prior Salesforce experience or equivalent
  • Even better:

About Us

DriveWealth is on a mission to make investing easier. We believe that everyone should have the ability to control their financial future, and that access to financial markets should not be limited by geography, wealth, or legacy systems. We are a global B2B financial technology organization dedicated to democratizing access to financial independence around the world. Our mission is realized through an API-based platform, empowering our partners to offer seamless investing and trading experiences to clients worldwide, all from their mobile devices. Our technology provides partners with a modern, extensible toolkit, enabling traditional investment workflows and innovative techniques like fractional share ownership. DriveWealth has evolved into a global platform offering trading of US equities, mutual funds, ETFs, fixed income, and options.

There’s never been a better time to build a category-defining business and there has rarely been a team better positioned for this opportunity. Our culture blends the pace and agility of a fintech start-up with the impact, stability, and discipline of Wall Street. We encourage creativity and experimentation while ensuring institutional-grade execution and regulatory compliance in everything we do. Join us and help build the future of global investing!

About the Role

DriveWealth LLC is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Principal Security Engineer to design, build, and mature security capabilities across our brokerage platform and corporate environment. Reporting to the Head of Security Engineering, you will serve as a senior technical leader, own complex engineering initiatives, and shape the architecture and implementation of controls that support the firm’s growth, protect client and consumer data, and meet or exceed regulatory obligations.

In this hands-on role, you will secure our AWS platform, Kubernetes services, low-latency trading infrastructure, and corporate technology. We are seeking an engineer who combines architectural judgment with strong implementation skills to deliver scalable security solutions through software and automation. You will also build and maintain the platforms and services used by Security Operations, provide security consulting to business leaders and other engineers, and partner with Engineering, IT, Risk, and Compliance within an innovative and entrepreneurial culture.

What You’ll Do

Security Architecture & Technical Leadership

  • Architecture Standards: Design and assist in the implementation of reusable security patterns and automated guardrails across product and corporate systems.
  • Engineering Delivery: Own complex initiatives from design and testing through deployment and ongoing maintenance, combining vendor solutions, custom software, infrastructure as code, and measurable control improvements.
  • Technical Leadership: Mentor engineers, conduct design and code reviews, and document architectures and runbooks. Influence technical decisions across Engineering and IT while balancing security, reliability, and delivery.

Product & Corporate Security

  • Cloud & Network Security: Engineer least privilege, workload identity, segmentation, encryption, and secure data access across AWS, EKS, EC2, DynamoDB, and colocated infrastructure, accounting for availability and trading latency.
  • Endpoint & Identity: Harden Windows and macOS, tune endpoint protection, and automate Okta and JumpCloud identity and device controls. Strengthen privileged access, phishing-resistant authentication, and secure configurations for Slack and other SaaS applications.
  • Application & Container Security: Embed threat modeling, API security, security testing, image
    signing, policy enforcement, and runtime protections into development, CI/CD, and GitOps workflows.
  • Exposure Management: Automate code, dependency, container, and infrastructure scanning. Partner with Engineering and IT to prioritize remediation, verify fixes, and prevent recurring vulnerabilities.

Security Operations Engineering

  • Security Platforms: Build, integrate, and maintain SIEM, SOAR, endpoint security, and vulnerability management services, including provisioning, monitoring, and documented maintenance and support procedures.
  • Detection & Automation: Engineer telemetry collection, normalization, and enrichment. Partner with Security & Threat Operations to develop and validate analytics queries, detections, and automated response playbooks across cloud, application, identity, and endpoint systems.
  • Incident Engineering: Provide subject matter expertise in support of threat hunting and incidents. Deliver containment automation and lead post-incident hardening.

Compliance & Data Protection

  • Compliance Automation: Translate requirements defined with Legal, Compliance, and GRC into tested technical controls, including SEC Rule 17a-3 and 17a-4 recordkeeping capabilities. Automate evidence collection and support audits and regulatory examinations.
  • Data Security & Privacy: Build and maintain data discovery, classification, access control, encryption, retention, and secure deletion capabilities to support GDPR and other applicable privacy and data protection requirements.

You Bring

  • 10+ years of relevant security, software, or infrastructure engineering experience, with a track record leading complex security initiatives from architecture through production operation.
  • Deep practical expertise in AWS and Kubernetes security, including IAM, workload identity, networking, container protection, and secure data access.
  • Strong working knowledge of endpoint, identity, and SaaS security across Windows and macOS.
  • Experience with Okta, JumpCloud, or comparable platforms is preferred.
  • Strong software and automation skills in Python or a comparable language and practical experience with Terraform, CI/CD, GitOps, and security as code.
  • Experience building and operating security platforms, telemetry pipelines, detections, and response automation, with attention to data quality, reliability, and maintainability.
  • Sound architectural judgment, strong troubleshooting skills, and the ability to prioritize risk, manage competing initiatives, influence cross-functional decisions, and mentor technical colleagues.
  • Experience in regulated financial services or another environment with demanding availability and audit requirements. Familiarity with NIST CSF or SP 800-53 is required. Brokerage, SEC/FINRA, and privacy compliance experience are preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent practical experience. Relevant security, AWS, Kubernetes, or GIAC certifications are a plus.

Location

This role is open to candidates in the following locations: New York City, Chicago, Austin, Dallas, Denver, Miami, San Francisco Bay Area, or Seattle. 

  • If based in New York or Chicago: This role is expected to come into the office on a cadence set by the Hiring Manager/Team.
  • If based in Austin, Dallas, Denver, Miami, San Francisco, or Seattle: This is a fully remote role, though you may need to visit our onsite offices from time to time.
  • If you're not based in one of the locations listed above, this role is not a fit, and we cannot accommodate remote work outside these locations.
  • Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. DriveWealth does not sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.

Pay Range: $185,000 – $235,000 USD

We do our best work when we're in the same room. To maintain the speed our partners expect, our New York, Chicago, and Lithuania teams work in office on a hybrid schedule. We've found that being physically side-by-side is the only way to solve complex problems in real-time and stay truly accountable to the products we ship. When you're here, you're working directly with the people making the decisions.

OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.
 

About the Opportunity

The Compliance Analyst conducts day-to-day monitoring, triage, and execution of electronic communications surveillance across email, chat, messaging platforms, and digital communication channels. Working within established procedures and SLAs, this role executes high-volume alert processing, identifies potential risk indicators, and escalates non-standard cases. This role reports to the Director of Anti-Bribery, Corruption & Conduct and supports the team by leveraging AI-assisted tools and ensuring high precision in daily surveillance operations.
 

What You’ll Be Doing

Operational Surveillance & Risk Detection
  • Execute Primary Triage: Perform daily review and triage of e-communications alerts across email, chat, text, and messaging channels within target SLA timelines.
  • Identify Risk Indicators: Apply foundational compliance and regulatory guidelines to detect potential policy breaches, misconduct, or operational risk indicators.
  • Maintain Audit-Ready Records: Execute precise data entry and case logging to ensure complete, compliant documentation for audit trails.
Case Processing & Escalation
  • Gather Case Context: Conduct initial background gathering and evidence collection on flagged communications to support case evaluations.
  • Draft Clear Case Notes: Prepare structured, fact-based summaries outlining key findings for non-standard alerts requiring upper-level review.
  • Escalate Complex Issues: Promptly escalate ambiguous, high-risk, or complex matters to senior analysts and leadership.

Few people get to build a bank from scratch. Even fewer get to build one at a moment when banking itself is being reinvented.


The Dollar is the best product in the history of the world - there is infinite global demand. But International Fintechs and non-US banks are left with two unsatisfying options to access it: Either they build on legacy clearing banks that are slow and unreliable, or they interface with middleware providers that don’t move and hold the dollars directly, but themselves rely on underlying legacy banks. Augustus collapses this stack by combining two things: A real, national bank charter (in organization), and Marble, our proprietary core banking system, built around intelligence, made of code.


We are a group of operators, unicorn early employees, ex-founders and people who walked away from degrees because they believe this is an industry and career defining opportunity. We are backed with more than $200M from Peter Thiel's Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Hummingbird, QED, Creandum, and the founders of Nubank, Ramp, Deel, Circle, Fluidstack, Fuse, and n8n.

The Role

You’re a Fellow at Augustus, deployed to special projects across engineering, product, and the wider company. You own a project end to end: understand the problem, decide how to approach it, build the solution, and get it into use.

The work depends on where you can have the most impact. You could build background coding agents, create a frontend component library, or solve an operational problem with agents. The common thread is a meaningful problem, a clear outcome, and ownership of getting it done.

You’ll work closely with the team your project sits in. They provide context, technical guidance, and direct feedback. You bring the drive to turn an open-ended problem into something that works. As you deliver, the scope and difficulty of your projects grow.

Get context quickly, ship early, and take on harder problems as you prove yourself.

  • Month 1: Join a team, understand the problem, and take ownership of your first project. Talk to the people who will use what you build, agree on what success looks like, and ship an initial version.

  • Months 2–3: Drive the project through to adoption. Work through technical decisions, collect feedback, and improve the solution. You’re becoming more independent and developing better judgment about where to spend your time.

  • Months 4–6: Take on a larger project or a harder problem, potentially in another team. You can turn an ambiguous brief into a plan, make sound tradeoffs, and deliver with less guidance.

We care most about your trajectory, drive, and curiosity. You don’t need years of experience. You need evidence that you learn quickly, push yourself, and finish things.

  • Steep trajectory. You’re getting better fast. The problems you can solve today are meaningfully harder than those you could solve six months ago. You seek feedback and put it to work.

  • Ownership. You care about the outcome. You involve the right people, raise blockers early, and check that what you shipped actually solves the problem.

  • Low ego. You can defend an idea, change your mind, and commit to a team decision. You care more about getting it right than getting credit.

  • You’re more interested in starting projects than finishing them.

  • You wait for someone else to notice that you’re blocked.

  • You only want to work within a narrow, predefined remit.

Hard Requirements

  • Able to build working software, demonstrated through projects, open-source contributions, previous work, or something you can show us.

About Polymarket

Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market platform. We enable individuals to express views on real-world events by trading on outcomes across politics, economics, sports, culture, and current affairs. Built as a peer-to-peer marketplace with no centralized "house," Polymarket aggregates diverse opinions into transparent, market-based probabilities that reflect collective expectations about the future.

We're growing fast, both in terms of volume ($21B traded in 2025) and adoption as an alternative news source. Our ambition is to become a ubiquitous beacon of truth in global media and we need your help adding fuel to the fire.

About the Role

When a market moves, our queues move with it. The Customer Experience team at Polymarket operates in an environment where volume can spike without warning, driven by breaking news, major events, or a market that suddenly goes viral. Real-time management here is not a background function. It is the difference between customers getting help and customers churning.

You will sit inside the CX Operations team, reporting to the Capacity Planning Lead, and you will be the person watching the queues when everyone else is watching the markets. We work with in-house agents and BPO partners, and keeping both aligned to actual demand, in real time, across multiple channels, is the core of this job. The forecast tells you what to expect. You handle what actually happens.

This hire matters because we are growing fast and our support complexity is growing with it. We need someone who has done this before, who does not need to be told when to act, and who can communicate a staffing risk clearly and quickly to the people who need to know. If you are the kind of person who stays calm when the dashboard turns red and moves fast with a spreadsheet, this role was built for you.

What You'll Do

  • Monitor queue volumes, service levels, and backlog across all channels and BPO partners throughout the day, minute by minute.
  • Reallocate agents between queues in real time when intraday demand shifts, coordinating directly with vendor real-time teams to keep their staffing aligned with ours.
  • Identify SLA risk early and alert CX Operations and partner teams before customers feel it, escalating suspected bugs or outages to Incident Response when volume patterns suggest a product issue.
  • Track schedule adherence across in-house and partner agents and flag patterns that are creating coverage gaps.
  • Produce intraday and end-of-day reports that explain what happened, why it happened, and what it means for tomorrow.
  • Feed daily observations back into the forecast and scheduling process so the plan improves continuously based on what you actually saw.

## What We're Looking For

  • 5 or more years in real-time analysis or Workforce Management in a contact center or support environment.
  • Hands-on experience monitoring multi-channel queues across multiple vendors simultaneously, not just a single queue or a single partner.
  • Strong spreadsheet skills and working knowledge of at least one WFM platform or ticketing tool.
  • Demonstrated ability to make fast, sound staffing decisions under pressure without waiting to be told what to do.
  • Clear, direct written communication, the kind that gets the right information to the right person in a Slack message without requiring follow-up questions.
  • Availability to support coverage around major events, which at Polymarket can happen on short notice and outside standard business hours.
  • (Plus) SQL or BI tool experience that lets you pull and analyze data without depending on an analyst.
  • (Plus) Background in fintech, crypto, trading, or another consumer product where volume is event-driven and unpredictable.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary & equity
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Full Health, Vision, & Dental coverage
  • 401k match
  • Hardware setup: new MacBook Pro, big display, & accessories

Pay Transparency

Base salary range: $200,000 to $250,000, plus equity and benefits.

This is a good-faith range for the level we're hiring at. Experience varies widely within a title here, so if your expectations fall outside it, reach out anyway. We're always happy to talk it through.
